description: This file is a PHP source file that sets up a web page for editing mail scanner configurations within the vtiger CRM system. It loads required classes, initializes Smarty templating, and populates template variables with mail scanner info.

classes.name: Vtiger_MailScannerInfo
classes.description: A class responsible for handling mail scanner information, particularly fetching details for given scanner names.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A class extending Smarty templating engine tailored for vtiger CRM, used to render templates with assigned variables.

methods.name: return_module_language
methods.description: Returns language strings for specified module and language.

methods.name: getAsMap
methods.description: Returns mail scanner information as an associative array.
